name: MedLex
tagline: Make sense of any medical word.

free: Try every app before you pay
end.paidLine: MedLex, Carecraft and Lumen in one pass
end.before: 7 days free, then £29.99 for your first year. Founding price until 31 Jan 2027.

beats.say: Pneumono, ultra, microscopic, silico, volcano, coni, osis. Forty five letters. A ward round in the morning. And a word you have never seen before.
Can you say it out loud? Can you spell it on a chart? And when someone asks what it means, will you know?
Breathe. Long words are just small parts, joined together. MedLex has you.

beats.title: Decode
beats.say: It starts with a puzzle. Tap peri, card and itis, and pericarditis explains itself. Every answer shows you why. Gastr means stomach. Add itis, and you have gastritis.

beats.title: Practise
beats.say: Your day is ten minutes and ten words, mixing new terms with smart reviews. Match each part to its meaning. Then flip it around, and build the word yourself.
imgs: Match the part to its meaning

beats.title: Library
beats.say: Every term in the library is taken apart, explained in plain words, and spoken aloud. Sixty six prefixes, sixty roots and a hundred suffixes, each with its own studio.

beats.title: See it
beats.say: Illustrated guides decode a term in five steps. Each body system lives on one beautiful canvas, with a hundred terms and outcomes you can tick off.

beats.title: Remember
beats.say: Root cards give you a picture and a hook. Card means heart. Hemi means half. A quick check after every card proves it stuck.

beats.title: Grow
beats.say: Travel nine eras of medical language, from ancient Egypt to Vesalius. And watch your mastery grow, one body system at a time.
Fourteen hundred and eighty terms. Twenty six modules. Fifty six illustrated guides.
MedLex is free to start. The full app comes with the Crown Pass, with seven days free. Decode your first word today.
